clips.title: The story
paras: Across Elwynn Forest, Red Linen Bandana marks the Defias Brotherhood. Its cloth hides a wearer’s face and can be put to use by local settlers.

Across Elwynn Forest, full Defias operatives wear woven red linen bandanas. In Northshire Valley, lower-ranking initiates and common thugs use coarse burlap masks instead. The crimson cloth hides a face and marks allegiance to Edwin VanCleef's rogue fraternity. It also signals their rebellion against Stormwind's crown.

Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp asks travelers to gather bandanas from outlaw encampments. Though tied to bandits, the masks are made from respectable linen. After washing and needlework, settlers can turn the cloth into sturdy clothing and bandages for the forest's working folk.
